reviews.text: I love seeing Adriana! She always understands exactly what I want and does my hair perfectly. I wanted to go lighter with my balayage and it turned out beautiful. I’m so glad I found someone here in California that I can truly trust with my hair. ❤️
Glenda was fantastic! It took her a moment to look at the photo of the haircut I wanted and replicated it perfectly 👌 Plus the bonus hair care suggestions. I would be coming back :)

Adriana gave me the most beautiful layeres haircut today for my very long hair, which was proceeded by a wonderful scalp massage/ hair wash! She's really kind and gentle too - long hair is not fun to brush!
